.complete-page{

    position:fixed;

    top:0;

    left:0;

    width:100%;

    height:100%;

    background:#fff5fa;

    display:flex;

    justify-content:center;

    align-items:center;

    z-index:9999;

}

.complete-card{

    background:white;

    width:90%;

    max-width:420px;

    padding:40px 30px;

    border-radius:30px;

    text-align:center;

    box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);

}

.complete-icon{

    font-size:60px;

    margin-bottom:20px;

}

.complete-card h2{

    font-size:28px;

    color:#ff4fa1;

    margin-bottom:20px;

}

.complete-card p{

    color:#666;

    line-height:1.7;

    margin-bottom:30px;

}

.insta-btn{

    display:block;

    background:#ff4fa1;

    color:white;

    text-decoration:none;

    padding:16px;

    border-radius:16px;

    padding:16px;

    border-radius:16px;

ChatGPT의 말:

원인 거의 3가지야. 아래 순서대로 확인해줘.

1. 링크 앞에 https://가 있는지 확인

잘못된 예:

HTML

정상:

2. 코드가 이렇게 되어있는지 확인

index.html에서 밴드 버튼을 아래처럼 바꿔줘.

HTML

    href="https://band.us/본인링크"
    target="_blank"
    rel="noopener noreferrer"
    class="band-btn"
>
    💚 씬느샵 밴드 입장하기
</a>

3. 버튼이 <button> 안에 들어가 있으면 안돼

이렇게 되어 있으면 안 됨:

HTML

    <a href="https://band.us/...">밴드 입장하기</a>
</button>

반드시 <a> 태그만 따로 있어야 해.

Ctrl + S
Ctrl + F5

그래도 안 되면, 밴드 링크 주소를 여기 붙여줘. 코드에 맞게 바로 고쳐줄게.

ChatGPT의 말:

좋아. 다음은 주문번호 자동 생성을 만들자.

완성되면 구글시트에 이런 식으로 저장돼:

SN-20260514-0001

1단계: 구글시트 제목 추가

구글시트 1행을 이렇게 바꿔줘.

날짜 | 주문번호 | 닉네임 | 수령인 성함 | 연락처 | 우편번호 | 주소 | 상세주소 | 배송메모 | 구매내역 셀프입력

즉, B열에 주문번호를 새로 넣는 거야.

2단계: Apps Script 열기

구글시트 상단에서:

확장 프로그램 → Apps Script

3단계: Code.gs 전체 삭제

Code.gs 안의 기존 코드 전체 삭제.

4단계: 아래 코드 통째로 붙여넣기

JavaScript
function doPost(e) {

  const sheet =
    SpreadsheetApp
    .getActiveSpreadsheet()
    .getSheetByName('시트1');

  const data =
    JSON.parse(e.postData.contents);

  const lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  const orderNumber =
    'SN-' +
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      'Asia/Seoul',
      'yyyyMMdd'
    ) +
    '-' +
    String(lastRow).padStart(4, '0');

  sheet.appendRow([

    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      'Asia/Seoul',
      'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'
    ),

    orderNumber,

    data.nickname || '',

    data.name || '',

    data.phone || '',

    data.zipcode || '',

    data.address || '',

    data.detailAddress || '',

    data.memo || '',

    data.orderItems || ''

  ]);

  return ContentService
    .createTextOutput(
      JSON.stringify({
        result:'success',
        orderNumber:orderNumber
      })
    )
    .setMimeType(
      ContentService.MimeType.JSON
    );

}

5단계: 시트 이름 확인

여기 부분:

JavaScript
.getSheetByName('시트1');

구글시트 아래 탭 이름이 시트1이면 그대로 둬.

아래 탭 이름이 주문서면 이렇게 바꿔:

JavaScript
.getSheetByName('주문서');

ChatGPT의 말:

<body>

<div id="loginBox" class="login-box">

    <div class="login-card">

        <h2>
            씬느샵 관리자 로그인
        </h2>

        <input
            type="password"
            id="adminPassword"
            placeholder="비밀번호 입력"
        >

        <button onclick="checkPassword()">
            로그인
        </button>

        <p id="loginError"></p>

    </div>

</div>

<div id="adminPage" style="display:none;">

    <div class="admin-header">
        씬느샵 관리자 페이지
    </div>

    <div class="container">

        <button
            class="refresh-btn"
            onclick="loadOrders()"
        >
            새로고침
        </button>

        <table>

            <thead>

                <tr>

                    <th>날짜</th>

                    <th>주문번호</th>

                    <th>닉네임</th>

                    <th>수령인</th>

                    <th>연락처</th>

                    <th>주소</th>

                    <th>배송메모</th>

                    <th>구매내역</th>

                </tr>

            </thead>

            <tbody id="orderList">
            </tbody>

        </table>

    </div>

</div>

<script>

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = "1234";

function checkPassword(){

    const inputPassword =
        document.getElementById(
            'adminPassword'
        ).value;

    if(inputPassword === ADMIN_PASSWORD){

        document.getElementById(
            'loginBox'
        ).style.display = 'none';

        document.getElementById(
            'adminPage'
        ).style.display = 'block';

        loadOrders();

    }else{

        document.getElementById(
            'loginError'
        ).innerText =
        '비밀번호가 틀렸습니다.';

    }

}

const SCRIPT_URL =
"https://script.google.com/macros/s/여기에_앱스크립트_URL/exec";

async function loadOrders(){

    const res =
        await fetch(SCRIPT_URL);

    const orders =
        await res.json();

    const orderList =
        document.getElementById(
            'orderList'
        );

    orderList.innerHTML = '';

    orders.forEach(order => {

        orderList.innerHTML += `

        <tr>

            <td>${order.date}</td>

            <td>${order.orderNumber}</td>

            <td>${order.nickname}</td>

            <td>${order.name}</td>

            <td>${order.phone}</td>

            <td>
                ${order.address}
                ${order.detailAddress}
            </td>

            <td>${order.memo}</td>

            <td>${order.orderItems}</td>

        </tr>

        `;

    });

}

</script>

</body>

2단계 — Apps Script 수정

Code.gs에서 appendRow 안 맨 마지막에 추가:

JavaScript
'배송 준비중'

예시:

JavaScript
sheet.appendRow([
  날짜,
  주문번호,
  data.nickname || '',
  data.name || '',
  data.phone || '',
  data.zipcode || '',
  data.address || '',
  data.detailAddress || '',
  data.memo || '',
  data.orderItems || '',
  '배송 준비중'
]);

그리고 doGet() 안에 이것도 추가:

JavaScript
status: row[10]

JavaScript
return {
  date: row[0],
  orderNumber: row[1],
  nickname: row[2],
  name: row[3],
  phone: row[4],
  zipcode: row[5],
  address: row[6],
  detailAddress: row[7],
  memo: row[8],
  orderItems: row[9],
  status: row[10]
};

수정 후 꼭:

배포 → 배포 관리 → 연필 → 새 버전 → 배포

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>씬느샵 관리자</title>

<style>
body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:sans-serif;
    background:#fff5fa;
}

.admin-wrap{
    display:flex;
    min-height:100vh;
}

.sidebar{
    width:230px;
    background:#182338;
    color:white;
    padding:30px 20px;
}

.logo{
    font-size:22px;
    font-weight:800;
    margin-bottom:40px;
}

.menu{
    padding:16px;
    border-radius:14px;
    margin-bottom:12px;
    font-weight:700;
}

.menu.active{
    background:#ff4fa1;
}

.main{
    flex:1;
    padding:35px;
}

.top-title{
    font-size:28px;
    font-weight:800;
    margin-bottom:30px;
}

.card-row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    gap:20px;
    margin-bottom:25px;
}

.card{
    background:white;
    padding:24px;
    border-radius:18px;
    box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}

.card-title{
    color:#ff4fa1;
    font-weight:700;
    margin-bottom:12px;
}

.card-number{
    font-size:28px;
    font-weight:900;
}

.search-row{
    display:flex;
    gap:10px;
    margin-bottom:20px;
}

.search-row input,
.search-row select{
    padding:14px;
    border:1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius:12px;
}

.search-row input{
    width:300px;
}

.search-btn,
.refresh-btn{
    border:none;
    background:#ff4fa1;
    color:white;
    padding:14px 20px;
    border-radius:12px;
    font-weight:700;
}

table{
    width:100%;
    border-collapse:collapse;
    background:white;
    border-radius:18px;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}

th,td{
    padding:14px;
    border-bottom:1px solid #eee;
    font-size:14px;
    text-align:left;
}

th{
    background:#fff0f6;
}

.status{
    padding:8px 12px;
    border-radius:999px;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:700;
}

.ready{
    background:#fff0c2;
    color:#9a6a00;
}

.shipping{
    background:#dbeafe;
    color:#2563eb;
}

    background:#dcfce7;
    color:#15803d;
}

@media(max-width:900px){
    .admin-wrap{
        flex-direction:column;
    }

</style>
</head>

<body>

<div class="admin-wrap">

    <div class="sidebar">
        <div class="logo">🎁 씬느샵 관리자</div>
        <div class="menu active">📦 주문 관리</div>
        <div class="menu">📊 주문 통계</div>
        <div class="menu">⬇ 엑셀 다운로드</div>
        <div class="menu">⚙ 설정</div>
    </div>

    <div class="main">

        <div class="top-title">주문 관리</div>

        <div class="card-row">
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">전체 주문</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="totalCount">0건</div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">오늘 주문</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="todayCount">0건</div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">배송 완료</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="doneCount">0건</div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">대기 중</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="readyCount">0건</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="search-row">
            <input
                type="text"
                id="searchInput"
                placeholder="닉네임 / 수령인 / 연락처 검색"
            >

            <button class="search-btn" onclick="searchOrders()">
                검색
            </button>

            <select id="statusFilter" onchange="searchOrders()">
                <option value="">전체 상태</option>
                <option value="배송 준비중">배송 준비중</option>
                <option value="배송중">배송중</option>
                <option value="배송완료">배송완료</option>
            </select>

            <button class="refresh-btn" onclick="loadOrders()">
                새로고침
            </button>
        </div>

        <table>
            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th>주문번호</th>
                    <th>닉네임</th>
                    <th>수령인</th>
                    <th>연락처</th>
                    <th>주소</th>
                    <th>주문일</th>
                    <th>배송메모</th>
                    <th>구매내역</th>
                    <th>상태</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody id="orderList"></tbody>
        </table>

    </div>

</div>

<script>
const SCRIPT_URL = "여기에_Apps_Script_URL";

let allOrders = [];

async function loadOrders(){

    const res = await fetch(SCRIPT_URL);
    const orders = await res.json();

    allOrders = orders;

    renderOrders(allOrders);
    updateCards(allOrders);

}

function renderOrders(orders){

    const orderList = document.getElementById('orderList');
    orderList.innerHTML = '';

    orders.forEach(order => {

        let statusClass = 'ready';

        if(order.status === '배송중'){
            statusClass = 'shipping';
        }

        if(order.status === '배송완료'){
            statusClass = 'done';
        }

        orderList.innerHTML += `
            <tr>
                <td>${order.orderNumber || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.nickname || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.name || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.phone || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.address || ''} ${order.detailAddress || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.date || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.memo || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.orderItems || ''}</td>
                <td>
                    <span class="status ${statusClass}">
                        ${order.status || '배송 준비중'}
                    </span>
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

    });

}

function searchOrders(){

    const keyword =
        document.getElementById('searchInput').value;

    const status =
        document.getElementById('statusFilter').value;

    const filtered = allOrders.filter(order => {

        const text =
            `${order.nickname} ${order.name} ${order.phone} ${order.orderNumber}`;

        const keywordMatch =
            text.includes(keyword);

        const statusMatch =
            status === '' || order.status === status;

        return keywordMatch && statusMatch;

    });

    renderOrders(filtered);

}

function updateCards(orders){

    document.getElementById('totalCount').innerText =
        orders.length + '건';

    document.getElementById('todayCount').innerText =
        orders.length + '건';

    document.getElementById('doneCount').innerText =
        orders.filter(order => order.status === '배송완료').length + '건';

    document.getElementById('readyCount').innerText =
        orders.filter(order => order.status !== '배송완료').length + '건';

}

loadOrders();
</script>

</body>
</html>

STEP 2 — 아래 코드로 교체

JavaScript
async function loadOrders(){

    try{

        const res =
            await fetch(SCRIPT_URL);

        const orders =
            await res.json();

        allOrders = orders;

        renderOrders(allOrders);

        updateCards(allOrders);

    }catch(error){

        console.log(error);

        alert(
            '주문 데이터를 불러오지 못했습니다'
        );

    }

}

HTML

<head>

<title>씬느샵 관리자</title>

<style>

body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:sans-serif;
    background:#fff5fa;
}

.admin-wrap{
    display:flex;
    min-height:100vh;
}

.sidebar{
    width:230px;

<body>

<div class="admin-wrap">

    <div class="sidebar">

        <div class="logo">
            🎁 씬느샵 관리자
        </div>

        <div class="menu active">
            📦 주문 관리
        </div>

        <div class="menu">
            📊 주문 통계
        </div>

        <div class="menu">
            ⬇ 엑셀 다운로드
        </div>

        <div class="menu">
            ⚙ 설정
        </div>

    </div>

    <div class="main">

        <div class="top-title">
            주문 관리
        </div>

        <div class="card-row">

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">
                    전체 주문
                </div>

                <div class="card-number" id="totalCount">
                    0건
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">
                    오늘 주문
                </div>

                <div class="card-number" id="todayCount">
                    0건
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">
                    배송 완료
                </div>

                <div class="card-number" id="doneCount">
                    0건
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">
                    대기 중
                </div>

                <div class="card-number" id="readyCount">
                    0건
                </div>
            </div>

        </div>

        <div class="search-row">

            <input
                type="text"
                id="searchInput"
                placeholder="닉네임 / 수령인 / 연락처 검색"
            >

            <button
                class="search-btn"
                onclick="searchOrders()"
            >
                검색
            </button>

            <select
                id="statusFilter"
                onchange="searchOrders()"
            >
                <option value="">
                    전체 상태
                </option>

                <option value="배송 준비중">
                    배송 준비중
                </option>

                <option value="배송중">
                    배송중
                </option>

                <option value="배송완료">
                    배송완료
                </option>
            </select>

            <button
                class="refresh-btn"
                onclick="loadOrders()"
            >
                새로고침
            </button>

        </div>

        <table>

            <thead>

                <tr>

                    <th>주문번호</th>

                    <th>닉네임</th>

                    <th>수령인</th>

                    <th>연락처</th>

                    <th>주소</th>

                    <th>주문일</th>

                    <th>배송메모</th>

                    <th>구매내역</th>

                    <th>상태</th>

                </tr>

            </thead>

            <tbody id="orderList"></tbody>

        </table>

    </div>

</div>

<script>

const SCRIPT_URL =
"https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbyHvO3uGfP35r_XrEuJYT7MHAEtURTVKIVzgWi3JII8cqUqMftd4Bxk6l08KrnjiK9VZA/exec";

let allOrders = [];

async function loadOrders(){

    try{

        const res =
            await fetch(SCRIPT_URL);

        const orders =
            await res.json();

        allOrders = orders;

        renderOrders(allOrders);

        updateCards(allOrders);

    }catch(error){

        console.log(error);

        alert(
            '주문 데이터를 불러오지 못했습니다'
        );

    }

}

function renderOrders(orders){

    const orderList =
        document.getElementById(
            'orderList'
        );

    orderList.innerHTML = '';

    orders.forEach(order => {

        let statusClass = 'ready';

        if(order.status === '배송중'){
            statusClass = 'shipping';
        }

        if(order.status === '배송완료'){
            statusClass = 'done';
        }

        orderList.innerHTML += `

        <tr>

            <td>${order.orderNumber || ''}</td>

            <td>${order.nickname || ''}</td>

            <td>${order.name || ''}</td>

            <td>${order.phone || ''}</td>

            <td>
                ${order.address || ''}
                ${order.detailAddress || ''}
            </td>

            <td>${order.date || ''}</td>

            <td>${order.memo || ''}</td>

            <td>${order.orderItems || ''}</td>

            <td>

                <span class="status ${statusClass}">

                    ${order.status || '배송 준비중'}

                </span>

            </td>

        </tr>

        `;

    });

}

function searchOrders(){

    const keyword =
        document.getElementById(
            'searchInput'
        ).value;

    const status =
        document.getElementById(
            'statusFilter'
        ).value;

    const filtered =
        allOrders.filter(order => {

        const text =
            `${order.nickname}
             ${order.name}
             ${order.phone}
             ${order.orderNumber}`;

        const keywordMatch =
            text.includes(keyword);

        const statusMatch =
            status === '' ||
            order.status === status;

        return keywordMatch &&
               statusMatch;

    });

    renderOrders(filtered);

}

function updateCards(orders){

    document.getElementById(
        'totalCount'
    ).innerText =
        orders.length + '건';

    document.getElementById(
        'todayCount'
    ).innerText =
        orders.length + '건';

    document.getElementById(
        'doneCount'
    ).innerText =
        orders.filter(order =>
            order.status === '배송완료'
        ).length + '건';

    document.getElementById(
        'readyCount'
    ).innerText =
        orders.filter(order =>
            order.status !== '배송완료'
        ).length + '건';

}

loadOrders();

</script>

</body>
</html>

<body>

<div class="admin-wrap">

    <div class="sidebar">
        <div class="logo">🎁 씬느샵 관리자</div>
        <div class="menu active">📦 주문 관리</div>
        <div class="menu">📊 주문 통계</div>
        <div class="menu" onclick="downloadExcel()">⬇ 엑셀 다운로드</div>
        <div class="menu">⚙ 설정</div>
    </div>

    <div class="main">

        <div class="top-title">주문 관리</div>

        <div class="card-row">
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">전체 주문</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="totalCount">0건</div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">오늘 주문</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="todayCount">0건</div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">배송 완료</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="doneCount">0건</div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">대기 중</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="readyCount">0건</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="search-row">
            <input
                type="text"
                id="searchInput"
                placeholder="닉네임 / 수령인 / 연락처 검색"
            >

            <button class="search-btn" onclick="searchOrders()">
                검색
            </button>

            <select id="statusFilter" onchange="searchOrders()">
                <option value="">전체 상태</option>
                <option value="배송 준비중">배송 준비중</option>
                <option value="배송중">배송중</option>
                <option value="배송완료">배송완료</option>
            </select>

            <button class="refresh-btn" onclick="loadOrders()">
                새로고침
            </button>
        </div>

        <table>
            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th>주문번호</th>
                    <th>닉네임</th>
                    <th>수령인</th>
                    <th>연락처</th>
                    <th>주소</th>
                    <th>주문일</th>
                    <th>배송메모</th>
                    <th>구매내역</th>
                    <th>상태</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody id="orderList"></tbody>
        </table>

    </div>

</div>

<script>
const SCRIPT_URL =
"https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbyHvO3uGfP35r_XrEuJYT7MHAEtURTVKIVzgWi3JII8cqUqMftd4Bxk6l08KrnjiK9VZA/exec";

let allOrders = [];

async function loadOrders(){

    try{

        const res = await fetch(SCRIPT_URL);
        const orders = await res.json();

        allOrders = orders;

        renderOrders(allOrders);
        updateCards(allOrders);

    }catch(error){

        console.log(error);
        alert('주문 데이터를 불러오지 못했습니다');

    }

}

function renderOrders(orders){

    const orderList = document.getElementById('orderList');
    orderList.innerHTML = '';

    orders.forEach(order => {

        let statusClass = 'ready';

        if(order.status === '배송중'){
            statusClass = 'shipping';
        }

        if(order.status === '배송완료'){
            statusClass = 'done';
        }

        orderList.innerHTML += `
            <tr>
                <td>${order.orderNumber || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.nickname || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.name || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.phone || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.address || ''} ${order.detailAddress || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.date || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.memo || ''}</td>
                <td>${order.orderItems || ''}</td>
                <td>
                    <span class="status ${statusClass}">
                        ${order.status || '배송 준비중'}
                    </span>
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

    });

}

function searchOrders(){

    const keyword = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
    const status = document.getElementById('statusFilter').value;

    const filtered = allOrders.filter(order => {

        const text =
            `${order.nickname || ''} ${order.name || ''} ${order.phone || ''} ${order.orderNumber || ''}`;

        const keywordMatch = text.includes(keyword);
        const statusMatch = status === '' || order.status === status;

        return keywordMatch && statusMatch;

    });

    renderOrders(filtered);

}

function updateCards(orders){

    document.getElementById('totalCount').innerText =
        orders.length + '건';

    document.getElementById('todayCount').innerText =
        orders.length + '건';

    document.getElementById('doneCount').innerText =
        orders.filter(order => order.status === '배송완료').length + '건';

    document.getElementById('readyCount').innerText =
        orders.filter(order => order.status !== '배송완료').length + '건';

}

function downloadExcel(){

    if(allOrders.length === 0){

        alert('다운로드할 주문이 없습니다');
        return;

    }

    let csv =
        '주문번호,닉네임,수령인,연락처,주소,주문일,배송메모,구매내역,상태\n';

    allOrders.forEach(order => {

        csv += [
            order.orderNumber || '',
            order.nickname || '',
            order.name || '',
            order.phone || '',
            `${order.address || ''} ${order.detailAddress || ''}`,
            order.date || '',
            order.memo || '',
            order.orderItems || '',
            order.status || '배송 준비중'
        ].map(value =>
            `"${String(value).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
        ).join(',') + '\n';

    });

    const blob = new Blob(
        ['\uFEFF' + csv],
        { type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' }
    );

    const link = document.createElement('a');

    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = '씬느샵_주문목록.csv';
    link.click();

}

loadOrders();
</script>

</body>

        box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    }

    td{
        border:none;
        padding:8px 0;
        font-size:14px;
        white-space:normal;
    }

    td::before{
        content:attr(data-label);
        display:block;
        font-weight:700;
        color:#ff4fa1;
        margin-bottom:4px;
    }

}

그리고 renderOrders() 안의 표 부분을 아래 코드로 교체해줘.

ChatGPT의 말:

아래 코드를 admin.html에 전체 삭제 후 통째로 붙여넣기 하면 돼.

HTML
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>씬느샵 관리자</title>

<style>
body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:sans-serif;
    background:#fff5fa;
}

.admin-wrap{
    display:flex;
    min-height:100vh;
}

.sidebar{
    width:230px;
    background:#182338;
    color:white;
    padding:30px 20px;
}

.logo{
    font-size:22px;
    font-weight:800;
    margin-bottom:40px;
}

.menu{
    padding:16px;
    border-radius:14px;
    margin-bottom:12px;
    font-weight:700;
    cursor:pointer;
}

.menu.active{
    background:#ff4fa1;
}

.main{
    flex:1;
    padding:35px;
}

.top-title{
    font-size:28px;
    font-weight:800;
    margin-bottom:30px;
}

.card-row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    gap:20px;
    margin-bottom:25px;
}

.card{
    background:white;
    padding:24px;
    border-radius:18px;
    box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}

.card-title{
    color:#ff4fa1;
    font-weight:700;
    margin-bottom:12px;
}

.card-number{
    font-size:28px;
    font-weight:900;
}

.search-row{
    display:flex;
    gap:10px;
    margin-bottom:20px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
}

.search-row input,
.search-row select{
    padding:14px;
    border:1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius:12px;
}

.search-row input{
    width:300px;
}

.search-btn,
.refresh-btn{
    border:none;
    background:#ff4fa1;
    color:white;
    padding:14px 20px;
    border-radius:12px;
    font-weight:700;
    cursor:pointer;
}

table{
    width:100%;
    border-collapse:collapse;
    background:white;
    border-radius:18px;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}

th,td{
    padding:14px;
    border-bottom:1px solid #eee;
    font-size:14px;
    text-align:left;
}

th{
    background:#fff0f6;
}

.status{
    padding:8px 12px;
    border-radius:999px;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:700;
    display:inline-block;
}

.ready{
    background:#fff0c2;
    color:#9a6a00;
}

.shipping{
    background:#dbeafe;
    color:#2563eb;
}

.done{
    background:#dcfce7;
    color:#15803d;
}

@media(max-width:900px){
    .admin-wrap{
        flex-direction:column;
    }

    .sidebar{
        width:auto;
        display:flex;
        gap:10px;
        overflow-x:auto;
    }

    .logo{
        min-width:150px;
        margin-bottom:0;
        font-size:18px;
    }

    .menu{
        white-space:nowrap;
        font-size:14px;
        padding:12px;
        margin-bottom:0;
    }

    .main{
        padding:16px;
    }

    .top-title{
        font-size:22px;
    }

    .card-row{
        grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
        gap:12px;
    }

    .card{
        padding:18px;
    }

    .card-number{
        font-size:22px;
    }

    .search-row{
        flex-direction:column;
    }

    .search-row input,
    .search-row select,
    .search-btn,
    .refresh-btn{
        width:100%;
        box-sizing:border-box;
    }
}

@media(max-width:600px){

    table,
    thead,
    tbody,
    th,
    td,
    tr{
        display:block;
    }

    table{
        background:transparent;
        box-shadow:none;
        border-radius:0;
    }

    thead{
        display:none;
    }

    tbody tr{
        background:white;
        margin-bottom:16px;
        padding:16px;
        border-radius:18px;
        box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    }

    td{
        border:none;
        padding:8px 0;
        font-size:14px;
        white-space:normal;
        word-break:break-word;
    }

    td::before{
        content:attr(data-label);
        display:block;
        font-weight:700;
        color:#ff4fa1;
        margin-bottom:4px;
    }

}
</style>
</head>

<body>

<div class="admin-wrap">

    <div class="sidebar">
        <div class="logo">🎁 씬느샵 관리자</div>
        <div class="menu active">📦 주문 관리</div>
        <div class="menu">📊 주문 통계</div>
        <div class="menu" onclick="downloadExcel()">⬇ 엑셀 다운로드</div>
        <div class="menu">⚙ 설정</div>
    </div>

    <div class="main">

        <div class="top-title">주문 관리</div>

        <div class="card-row">
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">전체 주문</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="totalCount">0건</div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">오늘 주문</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="todayCount">0건</div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">배송 완료</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="doneCount">0건</div>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-title">대기 중</div>
                <div class="card-number" id="readyCount">0건</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="search-row">
            <input
                type="text"
                id="searchInput"
                placeholder="닉네임 / 수령인 / 연락처 검색"
            >

            <button class="search-btn" onclick="searchOrders()">검색</button>

            <select id="statusFilter" onchange="searchOrders()">
                <option value="">전체 상태</option>
                <option value="배송 준비중">배송 준비중</option>
                <option value="배송중">배송중</option>
                <option value="배송완료">배송완료</option>
            </select>

            <button class="refresh-btn" onclick="loadOrders()">새로고침</button>
        </div>

        <table>
            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th>주문번호</th>
                    <th>닉네임</th>
                    <th>수령인</th>
                    <th>연락처</th>
                    <th>주소</th>
                    <th>주문일</th>
                    <th>배송메모</th>
                    <th>구매내역</th>
                    <th>상태</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody id="orderList"></tbody>
        </table>

    </div>

</div>

<script>
const SCRIPT_URL =
"https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbyHvO3uGfP35r_XrEuJYT7MHAEtURTVKIVzgWi3JII8cqUqMftd4Bxk6l08KrnjiK9VZA/exec";

let allOrders = [];

async function loadOrders(){

    try{

        const res = await fetch(SCRIPT_URL);
        const orders = await res.json();

        allOrders = orders;

        renderOrders(allOrders);
        updateCards(allOrders);

    }catch(error){

        console.log(error);
        alert('주문 데이터를 불러오지 못했습니다');

    }

}

function renderOrders(orders){

    const orderList = document.getElementById('orderList');
    orderList.innerHTML = '';

    orders.forEach(order => {

        let statusClass = 'ready';

        if(order.status === '배송중'){
            statusClass = 'shipping';
        }

        if(order.status === '배송완료'){
            statusClass = 'done';
        }

        orderList.innerHTML += `
            <tr>
                <td data-label="주문번호">${order.orderNumber || ''}</td>
                <td data-label="닉네임">${order.nickname || ''}</td>
                <td data-label="수령인">${order.name || ''}</td>
                <td data-label="연락처">${order.phone || ''}</td>
                <td data-label="주소">${order.address || ''} ${order.detailAddress || ''}</td>
                <td data-label="주문일">${order.date || ''}</td>
                <td data-label="배송메모">${order.memo || ''}</td>
                <td data-label="구매내역">${order.orderItems || ''}</td>
                <td data-label="상태">
                    <span class="status ${statusClass}">
                        ${order.status || '배송 준비중'}
                    </span>
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;

    });

}

function searchOrders(){

    const keyword = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
    const status = document.getElementById('statusFilter').value;

    const filtered = allOrders.filter(order => {

        const text =
            `${order.nickname || ''} ${order.name || ''} ${order.phone || ''} ${order.orderNumber || ''}`;

        const keywordMatch = text.includes(keyword);
        const statusMatch = status === '' || order.status === status;

        return keywordMatch && statusMatch;

    });

    renderOrders(filtered);

}

function updateCards(orders){

    document.getElementById('totalCount').innerText =
        orders.length + '건';

    document.getElementById('todayCount').innerText =
        orders.length + '건';

    document.getElementById('doneCount').innerText =
        orders.filter(order => order.status === '배송완료').length + '건';

    document.getElementById('readyCount').innerText =
        orders.filter(order => order.status !== '배송완료').length + '건';

}

function downloadExcel(){

    if(allOrders.length === 0){

        alert('다운로드할 주문이 없습니다');
        return;

    }

    let csv =
        '주문번호,닉네임,수령인,연락처,주소,주문일,배송메모,구매내역,상태\n';

    allOrders.forEach(order => {

        csv += [
            order.orderNumber || '',
            order.nickname || '',
            order.name || '',
            order.phone || '',
            `${order.address || ''} ${order.detailAddress || ''}`,
            order.date || '',
            order.memo || '',
            order.orderItems || '',
            order.status || '배송 준비중'
        ].map(value =>
            `"${String(value).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
        ).join(',') + '\n';

    });

    const blob = new Blob(
        ['\uFEFF' + csv],
        { type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' }
    );

    const link = document.createElement('a');

    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = '씬느샵_주문목록.csv';
    link.click();

}

loadOrders();
</script>

</body>
</html>

붙여넣고 저장한 다음 admin.html을 GitHub에 다시 업로드하면 돼.
